title: PikeFinance — Storage Collision Vulnerability Analysis
root_cause: Storage layout change after upgrade shifted the `initialized` variable slot → unauthorized re-invocation of the initializer function
steps: → drains entire ETH balance of proxy
other_code:
Attacker EOA (0x1906...e23)
    │
    │  [1] call initialize(attacker, ...)
    ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  PikeFinance Proxy (0xFC75...063)       │
│  EIP-1967 UUPS Proxy                    │
│                                         │
│  slot 0: _paused = false                │
│         (former _initialized slot       │
│          corrupted)                     │
│  → initialized check = 0 → re-init     │
│    allowed                              │
└─────────────────┬───────────────────────┘
                  │  delegatecall
                  ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Implementation Contract (SpokeV2)      │
│  initialize() executed                  │
│  → owner set to attacker address        │
└─────────────────────────────────────────┘
    │
